correctness.rationale: For all fields and symmetric forms, L_x=λ(x)Id+e⊗β_x, giving [L_x,L_y]=L_[x,y] and hence the pre-Lie identity. From x·y=λ(x)y+β_x(y)e, closure is exactly e∈S or β(S,S)=0. Count e-containing subspaces via Gaussian coefficients. Over odd finite fields with nondegenerate B, count totally isotropic subspaces using the quotient U^perp/U; Gauss sums give C_r and a double count of nested isotropic subspaces yields I_(r+1)=I_r(C_r−1)/(q^(r+1)−1). The nonsplit maximal boundary and parity cases are covered. Exact RREF exhaustive tests and raw multiplication checks in twelve prime-field examples returned VERIFY_OK; tests are not used to infer the theorem.

value.rationale: The full lattice of embedded subalgebras is an intrinsic nonassociative algebra invariant not captured by ideals or split retractions. The theorem identifies its nontrivial component with an orthogonal polar Grassmannian in every dimension/characteristic structurally, gives the full parameterized finite-field subalgebra distribution in odd characteristic, and explains discriminant independence precisely for even generator dimension, with explicit contrasting odd-dimensional cases. This is a natural complete classification and enumeration, not an isolated table or restatement of standard quadratic-space counts.
